neighbours.label: The subject of a reduced relative after an effect noun ('the impacts development is having on', 'the effect exertion has on')
fire: We study the impacts tourism is having on reefs.
The effects caffeine and sugar have on sleep differ.
They measured the effect stress has on memory.
The impact the drought had on farms was huge.
She wrote about the effects television has on children.
He doubts the influence money has on voters.
Few studies address the impacts mining has on streams.
The effect noise has on birds is well known.
quiet: We study the impacts of tourism on reefs.
The effects of caffeine on sleep differ.
They measured the effect of stress on memory.
The impact of the drought on farms was huge.
She wrote about the effects of television on children.
He doubts the influence of money on voters.
Few studies address the impacts of mining on streams.
The effect of noise on birds is well known.

predictions: The subject noun in the reduced relative fires. The same words after 'of' stay quiet.
